# ScoutPaw TV

> ScoutPaw TV is a calming entertainment brand for dogs and their humans. Five animated pups — Max, Rocky, Oscar, Buddy, and Bella — front a library of gentle music and soothing visuals, plus a small shop of pup-friendly gear. The mood is cozy, low-key, and relaxing rather than stimulating.

ScoutPaw content streams for free and is designed as a relaxing companion for naps, quiet time, and everyday calm — not as a medical or behavioral treatment. For anxiety or health concerns, owners should consult a veterinarian.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.scoutpaw.tv/): Brand overview, featured pup, and latest videos.
- [Characters](https://www.scoutpaw.tv/characters): Meet the five-dog pack — Max, Rocky, Oscar, Buddy, and Bella.
- [Watch](https://www.scoutpaw.tv/watch): The full library of calming videos and sounds.
- [Shop](https://www.scoutpaw.tv/shop): Plushes, prints, apparel, and accessories.
- [Top Picks](https://www.scoutpaw.tv/top-picks): Curated favorite gear for pups and pet-parents.
